बृंह् {vI.v} {c1c} {c6c} P. (बृंहति, बृंहित)
1 To
grow, increase; बृंहितमन्युवेग

.
--2 To roar. --Caus. To cause to
grow, nourish. {vII.v} {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (
बृंहति, बृंहयति-ते)
1 To speak.
--2 To
shine.

बृंहण a. Fostering, nourishing.
--णः A kind of sweetmeat.
--णं
1
Nourishing.
--2 The roaring noise
(of an elephant); Śi. 18. 3.

.
--2 Roared &c.
--3
Cherished, nourished.
--तं The roaring
of an elephant; Śi. 12. 15;
